hooks.name: wire-doctor
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${WIRE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/wire" "${HOME:-}/.agents/plugins/wire" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/wire"; do [ -f "$c/scripts/wire_launcher.py" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "wire plugin root unresolved" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python3 "$p/scripts/wire_launcher.py" doctor --warn
